components.name: Route Progress
components.description: A finite route rule and node sequence that resolves on arrival, then rests.

narrative.overview:
V4.1 is a premium institutional operations interface rather than a generic dashboard in university colors. A cinematic campus gateway introduces the Holy Angel University Student Council and routes people into governed services. Authenticated work uses an editorial command environment: persistent route rail, compact command topbar, exception-first operational brief, semantic queues, and separately authored light and dark worlds.

The dual-endpoint celestial theme control, kinetic menu, compact glass back control, production-grounded Request Center, local-only profile image preview, labelled role picker, and finite structure-preserving loading make state and cause visible without implying a backend write. Illustrative preview data is explicitly marked.
keyCharacteristics: Cinematic public gateway and asymmetric exception-first authenticated command brief.
Bundled Bricolage Grotesque display, IBM Plex Sans body, and Newsreader wordmark type.
Dual-endpoint celestial theme, kinetic menu, compact back, named command search, and six-result route palette.
Finite structure-preserving loading, mobile drawer and bottom navigation, full reduced-motion path, and no stale counts during refresh.

rules.name: The Route-as-Truth Rule
rules.body: A line or node must explain a route, relationship, or state; remove it if it is only ornament.

rules.name: The Signal-Rarity Rule
rules.body: Gold earns attention through scarcity: use it for active segments, focus, selection, status emphasis, and small marks rather than large decorative fields.

rules.name: The Explicit-Label Rule
rules.body: A status, quantity, or unknown is always named in plain language; type hierarchy may emphasize it, but never replaces the label.

rules.name: The Wordmark-Only Serif Rule
rules.body: Newsreader is the institutional signature, not a general-purpose body or heading face.

rules.name: The Earned Elevation Rule
rules.body: A shadow marks a layer that floats above the route; ordinary work surfaces rely on paper tone and hairlines.

dos: Do retain the oxblood/gold institutional identity and use gold as a rare route, focus, selection, status, and mark signal.
Do keep queues semantic, preserve row-to-detail relationships, and show status labels, quantities, units, and truthful "Not recorded" / "Not assessed" values.
Do use the bundled Bricolage Grotesque, IBM Plex Sans, and Newsreader roles; the preview makes no remote font or image request.
Do label every preview figure as illustrative and keep demo-only actions visibly non-persistent.
Do preserve keyboard focus, labelled dialogs/drawers, 44px touch targets, 200% zoom, no 320px horizontal overflow, and the reduced-motion path.
donts: Don't replace the route grammar with a generic dashboard card wall, decorative gradient text, or repeated metric tiles.
Don't use color alone for status, expose raw enums, or imply that a hidden control is authorized.
Don't fabricate live records, metrics, claims, or provider state; public surfaces remain narrower and calmer than internal workspaces.
Don't add perpetual shimmer, bounce, or ambient loops. Motion is finite and state-bound; only a genuinely live status dot may pulse.
Don't flatten dark mode into a light-theme inversion or revert the pinned N13 authenticated / N5 public navigation and Ft5 statement close.
